title: Self-referential
summary: Staff who report to other staff via manager_id.
description:
Staff who report to other staff via manager_id.

Why: Hierarchies live in one table via a self-FK. Nullable manager_id is what allows root rows.
objectives: lab_staff (id PK, name, manager_id nullable FK → lab_staff.id)
hints: Self-FK: same table on both ends.
Read gate errors as cause→effect: each message names what Postgres still lacks.
starterCodePrisma:
model LabStaff {
  id Int @id @default(autoincrement())
  name String
  managerId Int? @map("manager_id")
  manager LabStaff? @relation("StaffTree", fields: [managerId], references: [id])
  reports LabStaff[] @relation("StaffTree")
  @@map("lab_staff")
}
why: Hierarchies live in one table via a self-FK. Nullable manager_id is what allows root rows.
pitfalls: NOT NULL self-FK so the root cannot be inserted.
mappingNotes: Compare your ORM/schema code with the Equivalent SQL panel. The task gate introspects Postgres — only real tables/FKs count.
